messages:
emily_r: Heads up — customer NimbleCo says invoice INV-2026-099 is missing their PO number on the customer-facing PDF. They provided PO: PO-7788 but it doesn't show. I've attached their portal screenshot in the ticket. billing ticket #8421.
alex_k: Can you paste the invoice id and the raw API payload? Is the PO in metadata or purchase_reference? :thinking: 
emily_r: Invoice ID is 0a1b2c3d. Customer-entered PO looks like it's in metadata.order_id = "ORDER-332" instead of metadata.purchase_order. Portal form probably saved wrong field. Screenshot: [screenshot link]
samir_p: This sounds like the legacy ingestion mapper — when orders came from the old merchant portal we mapped order_id -> purchase_reference for some merchants, but NimbleCo recently flipped to new form. Could be a mismatch in webhook transform. I'll check transforms for merchant_id nimbleco-17.
maria_s: Can you repro via API? Steps we need:
1) Create test invoice via merchant portal with PO in the 'Purchase order' field
2) Trigger sync to billing (POST /webhooks/sync)
3) GET /invoices/0a1b2c3d and inspect `purchase_reference` field
Share the exact GET response if you can.
emily_r: Repro steps — did manual create on staging using NimbleCo account, then GET /invoices/0a1b2c3d response below:
```
{
  "id": "0a1b2c3d",
  "amount": 12500,
  "currency": "USD",
  "metadata": { "order_id": "ORDER-332" },
  "purchase_reference": null
}
```
so purchase_reference is null, PO ended up in metadata.order_id.
alex_k: Confirmed. That explains PDF template reading purchase_reference only. Two paths: quick fix — copy metadata.order_id into purchase_reference and reissue invoice; longer fix — update webhook transform to populate purchase_reference. Which do we want for customer?
emily_r: Customer needs the corrected invoice today for internal approval. They asked for a reissued invoice and a credit note for the original to avoid double-payment. They can accept a corrected invoice with same due date.
billing-bot: Billing workflow created: WF-10987. Assigned to finance_ops. Estimated SLA: 24h.
finance_ops: We'll handle reissue + credit. Need authorization from support lead. Emily, please confirm that tax/VAT amounts are unchanged and that no prorations required.
emily_r: Tax unchanged — VAT line 20% applied as before. No proration. Please apply credit for INV-2026-099 and reissue INV-2026-099-R1 with purchase_reference set to PO-7788.
finance_ops: Acknowledged. Creating credit now. Will post credit note and new invoice when done. ETA 3 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
alex_k: For root cause, I'll open an ENG ticket to update the webhook mapping and add a guard in the invoice generator that falls back to metadata.order_id if purchase_reference is null. Also add a small integration test.
samir_p: I'll own the ENG ticket triage. Possible owner: eng-plat team. Tagging @eng-platform.
emily_r: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and link ticket #8421 to WF-10987. :thumbsup: 
finance_ops: Credit issued CC-5543, new invoice INV-2026-099-R1 created. PDF link: [link]. Please confirm visibility in the portal before closing.
emily_r: Verified portal shows new invoice with PO-7788 in the header. Customer confirmed, closing ticket. :white_check_mark: 
alex_k: Follow-up: ENG ticket PLAT-334 created to fix transform and add fallback. Leaving monitored for 48h.
